propositions: Provider-prefixed model_ref strings (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8, openai:gpt-5.4) fail genai_prices.calc_price lookup while bare model names resolve correctly, causing unpriced rows to be silently dropped from cost totals without warning.
The LookupError exception is caught and swallowed without logging, making unpriced rows indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models in output.

Cost comparison bias exists where only Bedrock usage rows price correctly while Anthropic and OpenAI rows drop to unpriced, giving false appearance that Bedrock is the expensive provider when all three are measured equally.

Model id translation to resolve genai_prices lookups must be decided by registry membership in KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES rather than naive prefix stripping or split(':'), because some provider ids contain colons that would be incorrectly split (e.g. anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0).
Anthropic, OpenAI, and Bedrock usage rows must all price correctly when stored with provider-qualified model refs, with Bedrock remaining more expensive than Anthropic for equivalent models.
Unpriced rows must remain tolerated without breaking summarize output, but genuinely unknown models must be visibly distinguished from mis-formatted provider-qualified ids.
